jobs.description_text: DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW: The Player Development department is dedicated to fostering the comprehensive growth of our minor league players. Our mission is to advance the Boston Red Sox in pursuit of World Championships through a comprehensive and collaborative player development system. Our approach involves the creation of world-class player programs and efficiently scaling them across our player pool. Collaborating closely with other departments, we establish effective frameworks for exploration, learning, and development. Additionally, we work closely with Amateur Scouting, International Scouting, and Pro Scouting to ensure seamless player transitions into the Red Sox organization. Simply put, we strive to be the standard in player and staff development. POSITION OVERVIEW: The DR Defensive Coach is primarily responsible for the on-field implementation, execution, and tracking of evidence-based defensive and baserunning development for academy players in the DR. The candidate will play a key role in executing daily training initiatives and translating organizational priorities into a high-quality on-field training environment. This role also includes the opportunity to impact player development through player education, participating in player meetings, player feedback and other responsibilities that support the staff and players at the academy. As part of the responsibilities, the DR Defensive Coach will collaborate with players and field staff to maximize departmental buy-in.

jobs.title: Multibody Dynamics Analyst
jobs.description_text: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. We want you as a talented and experienced Mechanism Engineer to help us in our mission by designing, manufacturing, testing and delivering, fully inhouse mechanisms for Nyx. The candidate will be responsible for performing multibody dynamic simulation analysis and structural analysis for components and systems. They’ll need a strong understanding of kinematics, statics, material mechanics, stress, and mass properties. Key Responsibilities Own the multibody dynamic analysis across the Nyx program to drive design aspects of the program and systems/subsystems teams. Model, simulate, and verify the Nyx vehicle level separation kinematics/dynamics from the launch vehicle, as well as the capsule to service module separation. Perform kinematic analysis of deployment, release, and articulated systems, including motion envelopes, clearances, and interference checks. Support testing and use test data to correlate simulation models. Perform Finite Element Model (FEM) analysis on various subsystems and their components to assess strength, stiffness, and margins of safety. Perform acceleration, shock, and random and sine vibration, and derive environmental requirements for components. Document analysis results in clear reports and present them at design reviews and to stakeholders. Develop reusable analysis methods, tools, and automation for current and future programs. jobs.description_text: Wir suchen jemanden, der unser Broker- und Distributionsgeschäft auf Amazon verantwortet. jobs.description_text: We’re looking for a sales leader who wants to build, lead and win in a fast growing startup that’s changing how legal research is done. You’ll take ownership of our DACH sales team, help us move upmarket and play a key role in shaping the next stage of Pandektes’ growth. About Pandektes Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear. We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale. Pandektes has raised more than € 17.5 million and most recently closed a € 13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland. About the role As our Head of DACH Sales, you’ll lead our sales team across Germany, Austria and Switzerland and take ownership of growing one of our key markets. You’ll manage and develop a team of Account Executives working across a wide range of customers and deal sizes. Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love.
